node.statement: Fix universal constants C_co,e_co>0 witnessing the O(delta+epsilon) compression estimate in def-compressed-corner, and let e_cmp>0 be no larger than the thresholds in both lem-compcb-amplified-compression and lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities. Put K=21+2*C_co and e_full=min{1,e_co/2,e_cmp/2,1/(2*K)}. Under the root hypotheses with t<=e_full, the level-one operator satisfies ||Co_R-I_A||<=K*t<=1/2<1.
